## 1. Run it

:::tip[Exercise]
Use `params {}` in a map like \{a: 1\} when a &lt; b.
:::

```bash title="Terminal"
# Run the workflow
nextflow run hello.nf
# [!output]
# not a comment
Hello World!
```

<details class="success">
<summary>Command output</summary>

Done.

</details>

## 2. Change it {#2-change-the-workflow}

<CodeWalkthrough>

```nextflow title="hello.nf" step="Before"
println 'a' // [!annotate] Prints a
```

```nextflow {1} title="hello.nf" step="After"
println 'b' // [!annotate] Prints b
```

</CodeWalkthrough>
